themes.label: SEMICONDUCTORS
themes.note: The foundry, design, memory and packaging names that make Taiwan the centre of the AI chip supply chain. TSMC alone is roughly two-fifths of the index.

themes.label: AI HARDWARE
themes.note: Servers, power, cooling, boards and connectors — the pick-and-shovel layer that ships the racks the chip designers sell into.

themes.label: FINANCIALS
themes.note: The holding companies and banks that carry the index's dividend yield and its sensitivity to Taiwan's policy rate and property cycle.

themes.label: SHIPPING & AIRLINES
themes.note: Container lines and carriers — the trade-cycle read on China, the Strait and the Red Sea routing.

themes.label: PETROCHEMICALS & STEEL
themes.note: The old-economy half of the market: naphtha crackers, plastics and steel, where the oil and China-demand story shows up in earnings.

themes.label: BIOTECH & MEDICAL
themes.note: Contract manufacturers, medical devices and the domestic pharma names. A small, high-beta corner that moves on licensing news rather than the index.

themes.label: MACHINERY & CONSTRUCTION
themes.note: Electrical machinery, construction and the industrial supply chain behind the electronics cycle. The order book, not the chip cycle, is the driver.

themes.label: TELECOM & NETWORKS
themes.note: The carriers and the network equipment makers. The carriers pay the yield; the equipment names ride the same capex cycle as the foundries.
